Click'n'Load always shows the popup, the countdown can be cancelled, and the window has two tabs.

## ✨ Added

- **Two tabs, Instances and Collector**, the same shape the phone app's instance view uses. The window was one column: the instances, the send button, and then a collector far enough down that a window opened for one of them buried the other.
- **A cancel button beside send, visible only while a countdown is running.** Until now the only way to stop the clock was to pick a different instance, which is a side effect of another action rather than a way to say no.
- **Both version numbers link to their own release page.** A version answers "which build is this"; the question straight after it is always "and what changed". Built from the version rather than a hand-kept list of links.

## 🐞 Fixed

- **A caught container always goes through the popup now, even with one instance in the group.** Straight-through delivery for a single instance was written for the toolbar button and the context menu, where a picker nobody needs is exactly the manual step to avoid. A caught container is not that: it is the page acting, and the countdown exists so somebody can catch it before it lands. With one instance the window never opened, so there was nothing to count down and nothing to cancel, and from outside the extension looked dead even though the links had already arrived.
- **The countdown's arrows are back inside the field, with no ground of their own.** 1.13.0 put them beside it as two filled squares, which turns one control into three objects in a row and re-imports the exact property that made the browser's own spinner wrong: the complaint was never "there are arrows", it was that they arrive on their own dark background and crowd the value.
- **The colour picker looks like a button.** It was on screen the whole time as a plain filled circle among eight filled circles, with nothing saying it opened anything, which is also why the reset badge beside it looked pointless: with no way off the eight presets there is nothing to reset from. It carries an eyedropper now and sits at the end of the row, next to the reset.
- **The "report it" button is gone from the Problems card.** That card is for the report; the About card carries both routes to reporting, and a third door hard-wired to one of them was a second answer to the same question.
